note: Read 04:30-51:40 around every D-row. Engine echoes: بقى at 32:18 = بـ; طمي at 07:04 = English 'tummy' (her chat tummi). [speaking Arabic] holes 42:13-47:49 hide his Arabic; A35 rests on Amal's quotes.

row.amal_said: بس what's that has to do with your طم؟ شو يعني طم؟ ... بطني. Okay.
row.why: He dropped English 'tummy' into the Arabic sentence (her chat spells tummi; engine wrote طمي); sheet row 'stomach / belly | Bâ6en | بطن'; she asked شو يعني طم (طم = mouth; his 'Mouth' at 08:21 answers her question) and he gave بطني.

rulings.why: Tier 3, not tier 1: her chat 'tummi' shows he said English 'tummy'; 'Mouth' at 08:21 is him answering what طم means. Stomach is on her sheet.

row.amal_said: لا، لازم توظف. الناشف ما إله طعم.
row.why: He used the verb نشف for the adjective ناشف (sheet 'dry | Naashef | ناشف'); her لا answers the content (dried mint has no taste) and الناشف is her own sentence, not a flagged fix. Low: one long vowel, the engine may have shortened it.
row.english: I have dried mint, not fresh.

rulings.why: B, not A: Amal never flags the form - her لا disputes dried mint itself. Low because the vowel length could be the engine.

row.why: He meant ten to three (he had said عشر دقائق at 13:39) but said عشرين; Amal said عشرة, he repeated it and said Oops. Separate from A13 (word order of the time phrase).

rulings.why: Real: twenty for ten, she said عشرة, he repeated it with 'Oops'. Not a duplicate of A13.

row.why: حذاء is masculine so the adjective is أسود (sheet 'black (m/f) | Aswad'); he used feminine سوداء; Amal only said حلو.

rulings.why: Adjective gender slip Amal let pass.
S4 / engine: لا vs لو is one vowel. At 30:33 he asks 'You guys never say لا سمحتي' and Amal answers 'Yes, we do' with no fix, so she heard law samahti.

Cannot be verified - transcript hole: engine wrote أحدا مااا, and Amal's 'بدفع and مش مع. Which one؟' asks which of two words she heard, not a fix of a known form. The real payment fix is D7, 8 s later.

row.amal_said: Oh cash you don't need even بـ. بس بدفع cash خالص.
row.why: He put بـ after بدفع; Amal said out loud the بـ is not needed (engine wrote بقى); he took it ('Cash, okay').

rulings.why: Voiced 'you don't need بـ'; he accepted. D2.

row.amal_said: To come. So it's not to came. So it's to come.
row.why: After طلبت من (asked him to) the second verb is the bare present يجي, not past جا; Amal named it ('not to came, to come') and he said يجي.
row.english: I asked the employee to come.

rulings.why: Same slip for both readers; B2 (verb + second verb in bare form) covers it, no new bucket needed.

row.medi_said: اه، حكيت لك إنه أنا بقدر أدرس أحسن لما
row.chat: ana 7akaitla 5atibti enno ana ba2dar a7ki a7san lamma ashrab ahwetain.
row.why: He is retelling what he told his fiancee (her chat at 05:46 has 7akaitla), so 'to you' should be 'to her'; Amal let it pass. Low: near-repeat of A1 (04:34 حكيت لي) with a different wrong pronoun.
row.english: I told her that I can study better when...

rulings.why: Real pronoun slip (لك for لها), different from A1's لي; unflagged. Low as it repeats the A1 sentence.

row.amal_said: إله، إلي، إلك، إله. ... ما إله طعم.
row.chat: ma ilo ta3em = it doesn't have a taste
row.right: ما إله طعم = it doesn't have a taste
row.why: He did not know ما إله; Amal taught it with the إلي/إلك/إله set.
He ended on an extra-ت form بتتسأليني; Amal recast شو بتسأليني and he repeated it at 24:03.

rulings.why: His last word was the wrong form; she recast, he repeated hers. Not a self-fix.

row.amal_said: تذكرة. تذكرة، تذاكر. ... تذكرة is a ticket.
row.why: Amal asked إيش يعني تذاكر؟ and he did not know; she taught تذكرة = ticket (sheet 'ticket | Tazkara | تذكرة').
A habit with لما (I learn better when the lesson is early) brings in يكون; Amal recast adding يكون. B8, not C6: the fix is the added يكون, not a b-drop.
row.english: when the lesson time is early

rulings.why: Voiced recast adding يكون; B8 (bikoon for habits) fits, C6 does not describe the change.

challenges.why: wrong and right are identical (الأكل الأمريكي -> الأكل الأمريكي); his 36:50 line already reads الأكل الأمريكي, so the slip Amal recast (likely missing el- on أمريكي) cannot be read from the text - needs audio.
